These runtime dependencies agree with environment/Dockerfile:9-11 and solution/app/package.json:10-15. Both Dockerfiles and test.sh are byte-equal to the frozen template. No image-source dependency defect was demonstrated. Current golden/host-golden-all-20261001T062646Z/command.json binds input 6a1e1645d3f5518ba2b935fdb339053a96ae6cbfbaeb48546616d752f3133ca2 and image sha256:46fefc505dbcabf0d6cb4e54fea8f0880acde2f7896587750af967427598977d. Its RESULT.json records exit 0 and 142.922 seconds. golden/run-golden-20261001-062647/RESULTS.json records Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.8, MCP 0.0.79 and completed scripted browser work; restart-mcp-stdout.ndjson contains actual initialize, tools/list and successful restart_app responses, with actual-restart.json showing PID 16 becoming 347. This is direct Playwright product testing plus the restart MCP, not configured RewardKit/Claude grading. The indexed extension-scope2/row29-mcp-probe/raw-mcp.json additionally shows actual Playwright MCP initialization, navigation, authored execution, a successful save (201), and clean-context/reload readback. Its command uses the same image; source-binding hashes match the current tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile, server.js, package.json, test.sh and restart_mcp.py. It is limited unchanged-component feasibility evidence; its own command/observations state configured_judge_invoked=false. Current cli-arguments/RESULTS.json reports provider_invoked=false, judge_launched=false, and only inert Linux argument admission (functional largest argument 110375 bytes including NUL). It explicitly does not launch Claude, register MCP through the judge, authenticate, or produce a grade. The raw index lists Full configured judge completion/workload as not_measured, and runtime-evidence.json is absent. qc/README.md and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md require that measurement before clearance; scripted duration and source/parser checks cannot substitute. Hash verification: all 102 current_golden, 11 current_cli_admission, 5 current_source_checks and 13 unchanged_actual_browser_mcp_control indexed artifacts matched their recorded SHA256. No new runtime or provider execution was performed for this review.
counterexample: Evidence-boundary checks, not observed defects: a static app with health=200 could coexist with every installed dependency, so image inventory or an inert argv pass cannot prove it earns a correct grade. Conversely, a conforming vanilla-JavaScript frontend with the required Express/better-sqlite3 server is supported by the declared runtime, yet the present evidence does not exclude a judge/provider integration failure that would leave test.sh at its initial zero reward. The successful MCP and golden logs refute a blanket claim that the browser/app cannot launch, but neither establishes full configured grading.
suggested_fix: Supply an authorized full configured verifier run on these frozen bytes, including actual judge/MCP execution and final grading artifacts, and bind its raw logs and command to this input in runtime-evidence.json; preserve shared template files and keep this row uncleared until measured.
